data.desc: BIO-key International, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKYI) is a global provider of Identity and Access Management (IAM) and biometric authentication solutions. Its biometric-centric, multi-factor identity security technologies help organizations protect access to computers, applications, information, and high-value transactions for more than 40 million users worldwide. BIO-key enables organizations to select authentication methods suited to their security, operational, and user requirements, including biometric, passwordless, tokenless, and phoneless authentication. Its cloud-hosted and on-premises PortalGuard IAM platform supports Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Single Sign-On (SSO), and centralized access management. BIO-key's Identity-Bound Biometrics technology provides an additional approach to identity assurance by binding authentication to the individual rather than relying exclusively on a device or credential.
